name: court
notes: plain open ground; no cost basis stated in docs, defaulted to 1

name: the span, one tile
notes: width-1 chokepoint per Bel-Iddin's note; that's a grid-topology fact, not a cost -- this table only carries cost

name: high terrace
notes: riding impassable per Tasme ('cannot climb the terraces'); +1 wet per map_f00's terrain note ('stepped terraces (+1 cost when wet)'), applied here to infantry/armor -- unclear if a riding-wet cost is even meaningful given riding is already blocked outright

name: wall face / temple (impassable)
notes: labelled impassable in both map_f00.txt and map_f00_reference.png legends; flying=1 is my inference (open air above a retaining wall), not stated outright

name: the wall (destructible structure)
notes: impassable while standing; Enmet removes it turn 1 (prologue_structures.str_wall). This table has no state machine -- treat as ter_court once destroyed. Needs real structure-state wiring later, not just a static lookup

name: planted terrace
notes: no cost stated anywhere in the docs; defaulted to 1, revise if this should slow movement

name: stair
notes: no cost stated anywhere in the docs; defaulted to 1. These are the only gaps through the x rows -- worth deciding if they should be slower or movement-type-restricted

name: the image / statue (structure)
notes: occupies its tile as a structure, not steppable -- same pattern as ter_wall, see prologue_structures.str_statue

name: seize (Sargath only)
notes: functionally plain ground; 'Sargath only' is an objective rule (who may seize), not a movement cost -- out of scope here

name: channel
notes: flying only, per map_f00's own approaches list ('the channels (flying only)'); Sirru's note says water blocks feet but not arrows -- that's an attack-range rule, a separate system, not represented in this table
